tool_schemas.name: add-memory
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new memory for the specified workspace and actor, stores the provided content plus optional source/metadata/importance/expiration, and returns the created memory record (including its assigned id and timestamps) once it has been accepted for indexing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/actor_id do not match the required formats, content is empty, expires_at is not a valid RFC 3339 date-time, importance is not a number, source is not one of the allowed values, or unknown fields are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot write to the workspace or on behalf of the actor, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the request attempts a state that cannot be applied (for example, an expiration in the past or other rejected lifecycle constraints).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to store the memory in.

metadata.description: Optional structured metadata associated with the memory.

importance.description: Optional importance score used for ranking/retention decisions.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the memory.

tool_schemas.name: search-memories
tool_schemas.description: Searches memories within a workspace for the given actor using the free-text query (and optional structured filter) and returns up to top_k matching memory records ranked by relevance; this endpoint does not paginate and uses top_k as the only limit on result size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/actor_id formats are invalid, query_text is empty, top_k is less than 1, the filter is not an object, or unknown fields are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read from the workspace or scope searches for the actor, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if search/rate limits are exceeded, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or actor does not exist or is not accessible to the caller.

actor_id.description: Actor performing the search (used for scoping/auditing).

query_text.description: Free-text query to search for in memories.

top_k.description: Maximum number of memories to return.

filter.description: Optional structured filter object applied during retrieval (recorded for auditing).

tool_schemas.name: list-memories
tool_schemas.description: Lists memories for a workspace/actor with optional status and expiration filtering, returning a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses requests with invalid ids, FK mismatches, or when the workspace/actor are not accessible to the caller.

include_expired.description: When true, includes expired memories (still excludes deleted unless status='deleted' is requested explicitly).

created_after.description: Return memories created after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Return memories created before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

expires_before.description: Return memories with expires_at before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get-memory
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single memory by id within a workspace. Returns the memory record if found; refuses invalid ids or FK mismatches, and returns NOT_FOUND if the memory does not exist in the specified workspace.

include_deleted.description: When true, allows fetching a deleted memory (still returns NOT_FOUND if it does not exist).

tool_schemas.name: update-memory
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing memory (content/metadata/importance/expires_at). If content is changed, the service recomputes content_hash and schedules reindexing by upserting memory_index with status='pending' or 'stale'. Refuses FK mismatches, attempts to modify deleted memories, or writes that would violate workspace quotas.

expires_at.description: New expiration timestamp (RFC 3339) or null to clear expiration.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the memory. Allowed transitions: active->expired.

tool_schemas.name: delete-memory
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a memory by transitioning it to status='deleted' and setting deleted_at. Also invalidates or cascades the associated memory_index (by deletion or by marking it stale). Refuses deletion if the memory is already deleted, or if ids are invalid or mismatched.

tool_schemas.name: list-search-requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded search requests for auditing within a workspace/actor, returning a paginated set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses invalid ids, FK mismatches, or unauthorized access.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to list search requests from.

actor_id.description: Actor whose search requests to list.

created_after.description: Return search requests created after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Return search requests created before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of search requests to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get-auth-context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, authorized workspace ids/scopes, and current quota/rate-limit state as observed by the service (including active-memories usage and per-actor search rate consumption). Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to return scoped quota/limits for; when omitted, returns the caller's default/authorized workspaces summary.
